notes: tech.eu's Series A article (Left Lane lead, Balderton participating) does not mention Visionaries; in the Series B Visionaries is listed with the new participants, apart from the existing investors Balderton, SIX FinTech Ventures, Left Lane and Swisscom Ventures, so B is the entry.
